messages.content: What is the Shang Han Lun?

## The Shang Han Lun
The **Shang Han Lun** is a foundational Traditional Chinese Medicine text from the Han Dynasty, organizing 112 formulas by the **Six Channel pattern identification system** (六经辨证) [1]. It provides classical formulas like **Gui Zhi Tang** (Cinnamon Twig Decoction) for Taiyang channel wind-strike patterns, typically dosed at 9g each of Gui Zhi and Bai Shao [2], and **Ma Huang Tang** (Ephedra Decoction) for cold excess patterns [3]. Its core focus is treating externally-contracted cold damage diseases through precise pattern differentiation [1].
